title: Correct remaining PR-003 final-contract gaps
objective: Resolve bounded final PR003 timestamp, large Git snapshot, malformed packet and task-evidence accounting gaps while preserving historical receipts.
outcome: The PR-003 checker compares full RFC3339 fractional instants, hashes large immutable Git snapshots without missing-path misdiagnosis, returns schema-invalid packets as rejected reports, distinguishes unresolved symlinks from deletions, and compares completed owner/branch/changed-file scope with the concrete per-PR task binding.

commits.subject: Correct PR003 timestamp, snapshot, packet and scope checks
commits.instructions: Preserve full RFC3339 fractional timestamp order, stream large Git snapshots, return schema-invalid packets without throwing, distinguish unresolved symlinks from deletions, and compare completed owner/branch/changed-file scope with the concrete task binding.
commits.verification: Focused tests reject same-millisecond reversed fractions, hash evaluation/research-program/cohorts.json from Git, return rejected reports for null/noniterable packets, reject unresolved changed-file symlinks, and reject owner/branch/owned-path mismatches.

commits.subject: Record PR003 R2 evidence and provenance
commits.instructions: Keep historical receipts and R1 indexes byte-identical, add an additive R2 index and actual command receipts, bind historical inputs by Git commit/path/hash, and label this correction as Grok work without attributing Luna's R1 recovery to Grok.
commits.verification: Current PR-003.json validates, historical command receipts remain unchanged, and the R2 index cites historical R1 bytes as historical rather than as fresh checks.
